answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reduced by each unverified claim, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. The ledge is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the ridge. The beacon of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
